steps.content: The gunfire persists. Some instinctively drop to the floor, pressing themselves against it, while the majority panic and scatter in all directions, their screams blending with the clamor of trampling feet.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Ugh... help, somebody...

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Over here!
Pine quickly pulls her companion away and shoves her into a secret passage she had already scouted out.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Take this way, then run as soon as you're out. Make it a quick one, move!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: What about you? Pine? Pine!! Where are you going??
Pine has already rushed out, running against the fleeing crowd toward the center of the turmoil.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Well, well, something did happen—no, this is a real black swan event! An election that claims two candidates' lives? So filthy, so despicable, absolutely... fascinating!

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: What will this hit lead to? Is MK dead? How will this change the election, and... who's really behind this? Cavendish?

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: No, no way. She's got the upper hand now—there's no way she plotted this. Did MK stage it himself? But those bullets were meant to kill... Or, he has a Sinner in his corner? Could it be that MBCC Chief?!

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Haha... Hahaha! I was wrong. There could never be innocent airheads among those cunning politicians!! This is their true nature; all they do is plot upon plot! I'm not gonna fall for their tricks again!

Filled with wild imaginations of conspiracies and insider secrets, a wave of excitement floods Pine's mind. Completely ignoring the danger to her own life, she thinks only of retrieving all her hidden cameras to get her hands on the raw footage.
But just as Pine pushes through the crowd and reaches the second floor, she hears a heart-wrenching cry of anguish.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: What... No—

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: NO!! NOOO!!! Adrian!! Adrian, stay with me!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Someone, anyone... Call an ambulance!!
Amid the tumultuous crowd, the old man rests in Max King's arms. Warm liquid slowly escapes from the old man's body, trickling through Max King's fingers and dying his suit in a dark hue.
Pine freezes in shock. For the first time beyond her camera lens, she witnesses real bloodshed and death, her previous thrill vanishing without a trace.
She immediately thinks of using her power, but the ability she usually takes such pride in proves utterly useless in this moment.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: ...Damn it, not now. Come on!
She forcefully kicks aside the obstacles in her path, seizes a flag from the second floor, and charges directly towards Max King.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Let me help!! Where's that Chief?! Anyone?! Someone needs help here!!
With her calls unanswered, Pine grits her teeth and quickly creates a makeshift stretcher using the flag, trying to help Max King carry the elderly man out of the chaos-filled venue.
However, the elderly man musters a feeble shake of his head in response.

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Don't... there's no need...

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: This isn't... anyone's fault... No one made me do this; it isn't a sacrifice, Max...

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: This is my own choice...

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: ...You've chosen a hard path, sir, and walking it is even harder... I'm sorry I took shortcuts... I did things that were not noble, but I don't regret them...

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Because your vision shines so bright... It has guided me through the darkest nights, and I want you to go even farther...

steps.speaker: Vale
steps.content: Keep going... my young master... and stay gold.

Max King gazes blankly at the elderly man cradled in his arms, his usually inexhaustible passion completely drained as if he's suddenly found himself in a desolate wilderness. He can feel the once-warm liquid seeping from the body now growing cold.
An inexplicable surge of anger washes over Pine, yet the words of fury die in her throat. In the end, she can only lower her head and release a deep, heavy sigh.
[Black Screen]
Outside the ward, Max King and Pine take a brief break from managing the aftermath.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Back there... thank you.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: ...It's nothing. I was already there anyway; guess that makes me one of your supporters.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: Stay strong. You made quite a speech there. He also believed in who you really are.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: I've seen your channel. I know... you came to dig up dirt on me.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: You thought I was either a fool or a crook... just spouting around empty catchphrases for views, manipulating voters.
Pine remains silent, refraining from her usual mockery.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: You're right.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Everything you said was right... I'm a complete fool.
He bows his head in exasperation. For a long while, Pine finds herself at a loss for words.
After another prolonged moment, Max King lifts his head slowly. Despite his weary face, his eyes appear...
He has only one path left now. The person closest to him is gone, leaving him with just this single path forward.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...You're a capable person. You can see through to the truth of things.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Can I ask you to look into something for me?
Pine affects a professional demeanor.

steps.speaker: Pine
steps.content: ...Sure. Tell me about it.
